Klasse FrodoKEMUtils

java.lang.Object
de.bundeswehr.uniity.sedapexpress.utils.FrodoKEMUtils
public final class FrodoKEMUtils extends Object
Provides FrodoKEM key-pair generation, encapsulation, and decapsulation for the AES parameter sets FrodoKEM-976-AES and FrodoKEM-1344-AES available in Bouncy Castle 1.87.

FrodoKEM-640-AES is intentionally not exposed because it is not supported by the Bouncy Castle version used by this project. The raw KEM shared secret is passed directly to the common HKDF-SHA-256 implementation; Bouncy Castle's default KDF3 layer is not applied before HKDF. FrodoKEM-976-AES produces a 192-bit raw KEM secret and FrodoKEM-1344-AES produces a 256-bit raw KEM secret in Bouncy Castle 1.87. HKDF expands either value to the negotiated AES key length.

All random operations use EncryptionUtils.random; this class does not create an independent random generator.

Seit:
1.5.5
Autor:
Volker Voß

    • generateKeyPair

      public static KeyPair generateKeyPair(org.bouncycastle.jcajce.spec.FrodoKEMParameterSpec parameterSpec) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Generates a FrodoKEM key pair for the supplied Bouncy Castle AES parameter set.
      Parameter:
      parameterSpec - FrodoKEM-976-AES or FrodoKEM-1344-AES parameter specification
      Gibt zurück:
      newly generated FrodoKEM public/private key pair
      Löst aus:

      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the provider rejects the parameter set

    • generateKeyPair

      public static KeyPair generateKeyPair(KEYEXCHANGE.AlgorithmType algorithmType) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Maps a SEDAP-Express algorithm identifier to its FrodoKEM AES parameter set and generates a corresponding key pair.
      Parameter:
      algorithmType - algorithm identifier; only FrodoKEM976 and FrodoKEM1344 are supported
      Gibt zurück:
      newly generated FrodoKEM public/private key pair for the selected AES parameter set
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier is null or does not denote a supported FrodoKEM AES variant
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if the configured provider does not implement FrodoKEM
      NoSuchProviderException - if the Bouncy Castle provider is unavailable
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - if the provider rejects the selected parameter set

    • generateSharedSecretKeyWithEncapsulation

      public static org.bouncycastle.jcajce.SecretKeyWithEncapsulation generateSharedSecretKeyWithEncapsulation(PublicKey publicKey, KEYEXCHANGE.AESKeyLength aesKeyLength, byte[] salt) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Encapsulates to the supplied FrodoKEM public key, derives the AES key from the raw FrodoKEM shared secret using HKDF-SHA-256, and returns both the derived AES key and encapsulation.
      Parameter:
      publicKey - recipient's FrodoKEM-976-AES or FrodoKEM-1344-AES public key
      aesKeyLength - required AES output key length (128 or 256 bits)
      salt - common 32-byte HKDF salt exchanged during the KEYEXCHANGE protocol
      Gibt zurück:
      a SecretKeyWithEncapsulation whose encoded key is the derived AES key and whose encapsulation is the ciphertext that must be sent to the recipient
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a required argument is null, the salt is not exactly 32 bytes, the AES key length is not specified, or the key encoding is invalid or is not a supported FrodoKEM AES public key
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if HKDF-SHA-256 is unavailable
      NoSuchProviderException - retained for API compatibility; the low-level KEM operation does not perform a provider lookup
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - retained for API compatibility with the former JCA KEM implementation

    • generateSharedSecretKeyFromEncapsulation

      public static byte[] generateSharedSecretKeyFromEncapsulation(PrivateKey privateKey, byte[] encapsulation, KEYEXCHANGE.AESKeyLength aesKeyLength, byte[] salt) throws NoSuchAlgorithmException, NoSuchProviderException, InvalidAlgorithmParameterException
      Decapsulates a FrodoKEM ciphertext with the recipient's private key and derives the same AES key that the encapsulating peer obtained from the corresponding raw shared secret.
      Parameter:
      privateKey - recipient's FrodoKEM-976-AES or FrodoKEM-1344-AES private key
      encapsulation - ciphertext returned by the encapsulating peer
      aesKeyLength - negotiated AES output key length (128 or 256 bits)
      salt - the same 32-byte HKDF salt used by the encapsulating peer
      Gibt zurück:
      derived AES key, 16 bytes for AES-128 or 32 bytes for AES-256
      Löst aus:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a required argument is null, the encapsulation is empty, the salt is not exactly 32 bytes, the AES key length is not specified, or the key encoding is invalid or is not a supported FrodoKEM AES private key
      NoSuchAlgorithmException - if HKDF-SHA-256 is unavailable
      NoSuchProviderException - retained for API compatibility; the low-level KEM operation does not perform a provider lookup
      InvalidAlgorithmParameterException - retained for API compatibility with the former JCA KEM implementation
